empty.props.title: Nothing selected
empty.props.hint: Click an element in the view to see its properties and type here. Ctrl+A selects everything in the view.
empty.totals.title: The model has no elements yet
empty.totals.hint: Start modeling: pick a tool on the ribbon or describe the project in the Generate tab.
empty.sheets.title: No sheets yet
empty.sheets.hint: Create a sheet with the button below or with Sheets for levels, then place a view on it.
empty.schedule.title: The model has no elements of this category
empty.schedule.hint: Place elements in a plan or open another schedule tab.
empty.schedule_filtered.title: Nothing matches the filter
empty.schedule_filtered.hint: Change or clear the column filters.
err.nothing_selected: nothing is selected — select elements and try again
err.parallel: the lines are parallel — pick lines that cross
err.not_parallel: the edge is not parallel to the reference — pick a parallel reference
err.count_min: the count must be at least 2
err.degenerate: the element would become degenerate (zero length or self-intersection) — adjust the points
err.geom: the geometry could not be built — change the size or position
err.referenced: the element is used by other elements ({n}) — delete or reassign them first
err.opening_outside: the insert would end up outside its host — move it inside the wall
err.component_outside: the component would end up outside the wall — move it inside
err.off_wall: the point is not on the wall — click on the wall itself
err.newer: the file was saved by a newer editor (format {a}, supported {b}) — update the program
err.corrupt: the model file is damaged — open the autosaved or a backup copy
err.not_found: the element was not found — it may have been deleted; refresh the selection
err.unsupported: this operation is not available for the selected element
err.io: the file could not be read or written — check the path and permissions
err.internal: internal model database error, nothing was changed — save a copy of the project and report the problem
opt.cw_u_tip: Spacing of vertical mullions along the wall
opt.cw_v_tip: Spacing of horizontal mullions by height
empty.families.title: No families in use yet
empty.families.hint: Families appear here as you place walls, floors, members and components.
